title: Flutter Tutorial
description: Learn Flutter step-by-step, from installation to building your first app with widgets, layouts, and state management. Includes interactive code challenges and practical examples.

content.content: Install Flutter
Download Flutter SDK from: https://docs.flutter.dev/get-started/install

content: Extract and add Flutter to PATH

content.content: First Flutter App
A Flutter app starts with the `main` function and uses `runApp` to launch a widget tree.

content.content: Widgets in Flutter
Everything in Flutter is a widget. There are two main types: StatelessWidget and StatefulWidget.
Row & Column
Use Row and Column widgets to arrange UI elements horizontally and vertically.

content.content: ElevatedButton
Flutter provides multiple button types like ElevatedButton, TextButton, and IconButton.
StatefulWidget
Use StatefulWidget to manage dynamic data in Flutter apps.
